features: Separate optional autopep8 and pycodestyle addons and Python/notebook quality packs
92,155-byte pinned wheel download; no pip/global environment modification or per-tool APK
Python and notebook PEP8 underlines/Problems, syntax errors, undoable formatting
Project style configuration, stale source/config/project guards, independent cell identities
Visible notebook analysis with at most two concurrent requests
Runtime removal independent of the interpreter; normal component-manager inventory
No notebook bytecode writing into application resources; installer rejects caches, optional wheels and signing keys
